topic: holding on to people who left
lines: You glance at the empty seat every night.
The chair stays bare, the room feels chilly.
A monk once watched a candle melt slowly.
He said the wax joins the fire.
Your missing person is the wax, the hole is the fire.
When you become the wax, the fire keeps burning.
You can sit, breathe, and still feel the heat.
It hurts, but the warmth stays with you.
Follow for more daily Buddha wisdom for real life.
cta: Follow for more daily Buddha wisdom for real life.
caption: Turn emptiness into your own light. Share if you need this.
